name: @loomwork/task-authority-digest
description: Task-scoped authority (ADR 0150 slices 1+2, ADR 0152) end to end: a nightly incident-digest agent whose grant is derived from its reach, leases and signed reads, denial feedback to the model, cross-lineage provenance (directedBy), and a scheduled agent approved once with a grant per tick. Offline, scripted model.
